age.correction_help: Tae set yer date o birth richt, write tae info@horistum.com. Support checks yer accoont in private.
age.empty_catches: Nae catches shared in the group yet.
age.family_settings: Permissions fae a parent or guardian
age.grant_info: The members will see the bairn’s nickname an the content ye choose. A photie can gie awa the place. Ye can tak this permission back here at ony time.
age.group_preview: Share this catch wi the current members o {group}? Check the photie for ocht that could identify somebody.
age.group_rule: Ye can stert a group fae age 18. Gin ye’re unner 15, ye can jine wi an invite. Yer guardian can allou ye tae share in each group separate. Ask yer guardian tae write tae info@horistum.com tae link yer accoonts.
age.invalid_date: Pit in a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD. Tae chynge it efter registration, write tae info@horistum.com.
age.link_help: Tae link a bairn tae yer accoont, write tae info@horistum.com. The group permissions will kyth here ance the operator checks ye hae parental authority an the bairn jines a group.
age.local_journal: Yer private journal is saved on this phone.
age.no_permission: Ye canna share this wi ony group the noo. Check yer membership an parental permissions in Fishin groups.
age.registration_notice: Yer date o birth is private. Gin ye’re unner 15, yer journal bides on this phone. A verified guardian can gie separate permissions tae share catches an fishin-trip tips in each group ye jine. Keep yer address an yer exact fishin spot private. Fae age 15, new journals sync privately wi yer accoont anaw. Ye can stert a group fae age 18.
age.review_date: Date o birth: {date}. Yer age the day: {age}. Is that richt?
age.shared: Yer catch wis shared wi the group.
age.withdraw_info: This taks the bairn’s earlier posts o this kind oot o the group anaw.

atlas.help: The atlas lists watters in alphabetical order. Open the map an zoom in for touns, roads an contour lines. The online topographic layer asks openmaps.fr for jist the map tiles ye can see. The service gets yer IP address an the area on yer screen. Turn it aff for the offline map. Tap a marker or a group o markers tae choose a watter. Watters wi nae published position bide in the list. The same settin turns on aerial or satellite images in the watter details. CUZK or EOX gets the map area an the device’s IP address.
atlas.location_explanation: Use yer approximate location ance tae pick the country an sort watters by distance. Ye can choose a country in Filters anaw.
atlas.location_failed: Canna find yer location. Ye can pick a country or try again in Filters.
atlas.location_use: Find the country I’m fishin in
atlas.tiles_unavailable: Some o the map detail isna available. The offline fishin markers an available outlines are still shawn.
atlas_map.no_position: The source has nae coordinates. A name search micht find mair nor ae place.
atlas_map.open: Open in a map or navigation app
atlas_map.reference: Published position on the watter. Check access when ye get there.

atlas_settings.the_phone_checks_the_atla: The phone checks the atlas when it’s online. Gin Android pits the check aff, the app catches up when ye open it.
atlas_settings.the_update_failed_your_pr: The update didna wirk. Ye can still use yer earlier atlas.
atlas_settings.the_updated_atlas_is_avai: The updated atlas is ready tae use offline.

field-hints.activity-method: Choose a method tae shaw jist the trips whaur folk fished that wey.
field-hints.activity-month: Pick the calendar month for the trips folk shared on this watter.
field-hints.activity-target: Shaw trips whaur anglers were efter the chosen fish.
field-hints.activityContribution.activit: Pick the method ye used on this trip. Yer trip will coont in the figures for that method.
Pick the fish ye were efter. Ye can note the target even gin ye didna catch onything.
field-hints.biography: Tell folk mair aboot yer fishin experience or the techniques ye like best.
field-hints.catch-country-scope: The list sterts wi species recorded in the country o yer trip. Choose aw Europe tae search the hale catalogue.
field-hints.catch-search: Search by common or scientific name. Ye can leave oot accents.
field-hints.discussion-day: Ye can pit the date o yer trip in the reply sae readers ken when it happened.
field-hints.fish: Pick a fish fae the results, or choose Ither species tae pit in a name. Open the rules for this catch tae check the watter an the trip date.
field-hints.fish-water-class: Pick the kind o watter shawn on yer permit. The minimum size an local restrictions can differ atween troot watters an ither watters.
field-hints.hometown: Pit in the toun or area ye want folk tae see on yer profile. There’s nae need for a street address.
field-hints.kind: Say whether this point is whaur ye stood or whaur the fish took the bait.
field-hints.lat: Pit in latitude in decimal degrees fae −90 tae 90. Use a minus sign sooth o the equator.
field-hints.length: Pit in the measured length in centimetres, for example 42.5. Leave this blank gin ye didna measure the fish.
field-hints.lon: Pit in longitude in decimal degrees fae −180 tae 180. Use a minus sign wast o Greenwich.
field-hints.lookup-class: Gin the atlas disna gie the kind o watter, check yer permit.
field-hints.lookup-species: Pick a species tae see its recorded size limit an restrictions on the chosen day. Rules for the hale watter are shawn separate.
field-hints.market-water-search: Search by name or number, syne choose a watter below tae see its tips an figures.
field-hints.newCatch.technique: Describe hoo ye fished, for instance spinnin or float fishin. It’s saved beside the catch in yer journal.
field-hints.offer-country: This limits the choice o species baith here an in the catalogue. Choose the watter for the offer separate.
field-hints.offer-day: Pit in the day ye used the technique. Buyers can see the date afore they buy.
field-hints.offer-species: Pick the fish yer technique is meant for. The offer keeps its scientific name.
field-hints.offer-water-search: Pit in pairt o the name, number or organisation, syne pick the exact watter for this offer fae the list below.
field-hints.profile-photo: Choose a profile photie fae this device an check the preview afore ye save.
field-hints.public-day: Shaw the exact day o the catch as weel as the month on the public card.
field-hints.public-length: Include the length fae the photie review on the public card.
field-hints.public-photo: Pit the catch photie on the public card. Check whit’s in the background afore ye publish it.
field-hints.public-water: Shaw the registered watter on the public card tae onybody wi the link.
field-hints.review-length: Pit in the length in centimetres for the review result ye chose. Gin the evidence isna enough, nae length is recorded.
field-hints.rule-water-search: Search by watter name or number. Gin there’s ae match, its rules open straight awa. Gin there are several, tap ane o the suggestions below the search box.
field-hints.search: Search by watter name, registry number or toun. In Favourites ye’ll search only the watters ye’ve saved.
field-hints.section: Pick the stretch whaur ye mean tae fish. The main channel an the side stretches can hae different rules.
field-hints.share-bait: Pit the bait ye noted for this catch in the message.
field-hints.share-day: Shaw the recipient the exact day o yer trip.
field-hints.share-length: Pit the catch length fae yer journal in the message.
field-hints.share-photo: Send the catch photie wi the message. Check whit’s visible in the background.
field-hints.share-technique: Include the method ye noted for this catch.
field-hints.share-water: Pit the watter name fae the trip in the message.
field-hints.shared: Save wi this option on tae let ither signed-in anglers see yer profile.
field-hints.species: Pick the species ye want tae check the close season for, on the chosen stretch an day.
field-hints.tagline: Write a short line tae introduce yersel on yer angler profile.
field-hints.trip-search: Find saved trips by the watter name or its published number. Ye can leave oot spaces an accents. Clear the search tae see aw yer trips.
field-hints.water-country: The country ye choose applies tae search results, favourites an nearby watters.
field-hints.water-name: Name the watter for this private trip. Yer ain name disna go intae the watter atlas.
field-hints.water-parking: Shaw watters wi a catalogue or shared parkin place on the list or map. Open a watter tae choose a cair park an get directions.
field-hints.water-search: Search the offline atlas by name or number. Tap a suggestion, or use whit ye typed as a private watter name for this trip. Clear the search tae bring back yer last choice.

help-topics.accounts.steps.2: Gin ye’ve forgotten yer password, ask for a reset an use the link in the latest email. Use Android Back tae get back fae yer mail app. Ye can sign oot in yer accoont settings an find whaur tae send a deletion request.
help-topics.catalog.steps.2: Search by the local or scientific name. Country lists use sightin records an published checklists. Ye can pick a country the same wey when ye mak an offer. The hale catalogue includes species wi nae sic records. Open a species tae see its scientific name, kent distribution an sources.
help-topics.forum.steps.1: Open the posts fae anglers on a watter. Share whit ye saw, speir a question, or open a thread an reply tae a particular post. The body that asked the question can mark a reply as helpful.
help-topics.profile.steps.3: In yer ain profile, open Age an fishin licence tae set a reminder afore it runs oot. In Settings, choose App language tae use anither leid than the phone’s.
help-topics.start.steps.2: In the atlas, choose a country or sort by whaur ye are. Yer phone measures the distance tae the watter on the map or its nearest kent point. Watters wi nae coordinates bide at the end o the list.
help-topics.start.steps.3: Open Settings tae mak the text bigger, keep the screen on, manage offline atlas updates or choose alerts. While the journal is open, the phone uses yer approximate location tae find nearby watters. Post alerts check the public discussions when Android allous background wark.
help-topics.waters.steps.1: Tap the watter map tae choose a map app. Gin the source gies an access point, the map uses it. Itherwise it opens a published point on the watter, or looks up the name gin there are nae coordinates. The source link opens the original record.
help-topics.waters.steps.3: Low watter, deid fish an reported closures are coonted separate for each watter. Gin three different accoonts report the same issue within 24 hours, the alert is highlightit. Ye can tak back yer ain report. Check current fishin restrictions wi the manager.
license.conflict: The profile wis chynged on anither device. Load the saved details again afore ye edit.

license.privacy: Ye can save yer age, fishin licence expiry date an reminder choice in yer private accoont. Ither anglers canna see them. Ye can clear them in yer profile. Android keeps the date an reminder on this device tae notify ye offline. Signin oot clears that local reminder.
license.private: Thir details are optional an bide private even gin yer angler profile is public. Leave the expiry date blank gin yer licence has nae end date.

The parkin filter includes shared points when ye’re online.

store.delete-account: Angler tae Angler · Delete yer accoont
store.deletion_scope: Deletin removes yer hosted identity, private profile an online journal, photies an aw. Clear the app data on ilka phone tae remove its local copy. Folk ye shared wi micht still hae their copies. Transaction records needed for the accoonts an unsettled payments are kept separate. Ask the operator hoo lang the records for yer transaction are kept. Buyers keep the version o a tip they bocht even efter its author deletes their accoont.
store.deletion_steps: Email the operator fae yer registered address an ask tae delete yer Angler tae Angler accoont. Ye can stert this request fae Accoont in the app anaw. Niver send passwords or payment details. The operator checks the accoont is yours afore deletin it.
store.payment_data: Google handles Play checkout. The operator processes purchase references, credit allocations, refunds an payouts tae run the mercat an keep its accoonts. Public offers contain the information the author chose tae publish.
store.private_data: Gin ye turn on private sync, existin an future journal entries, photies, exact locations, notes an bookmarks are saved unner yer accoont. Yer online journal is private. Tap Journal tae see the sync status. Delete a trip tae sync its removal anaw.
sync.check_failed: Saved on this device. Canna check whether yer accoont has an online journal.
sync.conflict: The same entry wis edited on baith devices. Pick the version tae keep.
sync.consent: Save existin an future trips, catches, exact locations, notes, photies, bookmarks an atlas settings privately in yer accoont. A new device restores yer synced journal when ye sign in.
sync.disabled: Saved on this device. Private sync is aff.
sync.failed: Canna sync wi yer accoont. Yer local entries are saved. Try ance mair.
sync.full: Yer private journal storage is fu. Yer edits are saved on this device.
sync.new_account: Yer new journal is saved privately in yer accoont an wirks offline. It includes trips, catches, notes, exact locations an photies. Ye can link an aulder journal on this device separate.
